verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Itsy bitsy spider climbed up the water spout
Down came the rain and washed the spider out
Out came the sunshine and dried up all the rain
And itsy bitsy spider climbed up the spout again

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: 小小的蜘蛛往呀往上爬
大雨哗啦啦，把蜘蛛冲下
太阳出来了，晒干了雨水
小小的蜘蛛往呀往上爬

measuredNoteEdits.reason: "Down": D4 for 0.21 s rising straight into E4; the other three verses start this line on E. A slide into the note, just over the automatic 0.20 s limit.

Verse 1 sings "climbed up the spout a-gain" as E E D C D E(+C). In verse 2 the same notes are at 41.74 E, 42.09 E, 42.35 D, 42.62 C, 42.85 D, 43.23 E, 43.39 C; the matcher had left the D at 42.35 without a word and put every later word one note late.

Verse 3 (first Mandarin verse) sings 蛛 on E4 then 往 on D4 (55.05, 55.73). Here the E4 is held 72.85-73.49 with a dip at 73.35 and the D4 starts at 73.49; the matcher had put 往 on the last 0.14 s of the E4.

en-2.reason: Verse 1 ends with "again" sung E4 then down to a held C4 (21.21-21.82 s), the same shape as the end of verse 2 (43.23 E4, 43.39 C4). The automatic boundary (21.17 s) gave that C4 to verse 2 as its first word, 5 s before the rest of the verse. Boundary moved into the silence after it.
